name: Seed Time And Harvest
overview: Scripture reveals the divine principle of seed time and harvest as a steadfast order established by God, enduring as long as the earth remains (Genesis 8:22). This principle not only governs the natural world but also illustrates spiritual truths, as Jesus taught in the parables where the kingdom of God is likened to seed sown in a field representing the world, producing either good fruit or tares (Matthew 13:38; Mark 4:26). The abundance of harvest reflects God's goodness and blessing upon the year (Psalms 65:11), while spiritual receptivity determines whether one receives more or loses what little they have (Matthew 13:12). Thus, seed time and harvest embody both God's providential care and the moral responsibility of believers to respond faithfully to His word.
